requested_outcome: Make administration reports open and save quickly by persisting immutable historical Biz, call and WhatsApp data and refreshing only mutable periods.
natural_destination: VII administration business-performance and lead reports
authorization_boundary: Local code, tests and release candidate are authorized. Production publication remains a separate action unless explicitly authorized.

lesson_bundle.reason: Caching must preserve exact metric semantics, date basis and source truth.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Historical snapshots must return the same source-derived values and expose freshness rather than fabricate completeness.

lesson_bundle.reason: The administration system is a daily operational product and saved state must survive reload.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Cached reports persist in the server database, survive a new request and do not depend on browser memory.

lesson_bundle.reason: A cache optimization can silently regress data correctness or refresh behavior.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Tests cover cold, warm, immutable, mutable, forced refresh, failure fallback and affected report families.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The same historical Biz period is fetched from the supplier again and remains slow.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Mark a range ending before today as immutable and reuse its saved snapshot unless an administrator explicitly forces refresh.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A second and later historical read makes zero supplier calls, including after the ordinary six-hour freshness window.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Only Biz is cached while WhatsApp, calls or the base report still recompute unnecessarily.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Inventory all report sources and apply persistent historical cache policy to the shared report layer and local lead report.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Business performance, conversion detail and WhatsApp report tests prove persistent reuse for closed periods.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The cache serves an incomplete result as complete or never refreshes current-day data.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep current-day ranges short-lived, preserve explicit force refresh and report cache metadata.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Mutable-period tests expire normally and stale-source failure falls back only to the last good saved result.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A large report still waits for all Biz businesses even when most are already saved.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Load saved successes and saved failures before batching and submit only unresolved targets.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Batch selection and API tests show cached targets are not sent upstream again.

affected_family: Biz conversion summary and contact detail report

midpoint_gate.trigger: After immutable historical cache policy and unit tests pass, before adding scheduled warming or UI changes.
checks: Historical range remains fresh after ordinary TTL
Forced refresh still reaches the supplier

attack_questions: Can a closed historical range trigger an unforced supplier request?
Can current-day data become permanently frozen?
Can a cache write or supplier failure erase the last good report?
Can two equivalent parameter objects create different report keys?
Can a report claim full coverage when targets failed?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Authenticated administration report on the exact release candidate, then the published version only after publication authorization.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Automated tests for report cache, Biz snapshots, report rows, WhatsApp leads and scheduler integration.

effectiveness.baseline: Observed implementation uses a six-hour Biz snapshot TTL and revalidates historical exact ranges after expiry; an all-business pull can take many minutes.
effectiveness.target: Previously saved closed-period report reads perform no supplier calls and complete from D1 storage.
